recipe.title: Gourmet Keto Mediterranean 'Rice' and 'Quinoa' Herb Pilaf
recipe.description: A sophisticated, low-carb chef's spin on traditional pilaf, combining light cauliflower rice and nutty hemp seed 'quinoa' tossed in garlic butter, fresh herbs, toasted pine nuts, and tangy feta.

ingredients.item: Chicken bone broth or rich vegetable broth
Fresh flat-leaf parsley and dill, finely chopped
Sea salt and cracked black pepper

instructions.text: Place a large skillet over medium heat. Add pine nuts and dry toast for 2-3 minutes until golden and fragrant, then set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter with olive oil over medium-low heat. Add minced shallot and garlic, sweating them for 3-4 minutes until translucent and aromatic without browning.
Add the hemp seeds ('quinoa') to the skillet and toast in the butter for 2 minutes to bring out their nutty flavor.
Increase heat to medium-high. Add the cauliflower rice and toss well to coat in the garlic-herb butter.
Pour in the bone broth and reduce heat to medium. Cover and steam for 4-5 minutes until the cauliflower rice is tender yet retains a slight bite.
Remove lid and stir in lemon juice, lemon zest, chopped parsley, dill, toasted pine nuts, salt, and pepper. Cook uncovered for 2 minutes to allow any remaining moisture to evaporate.
Divide between two warm bowls, top with crumbled feta cheese, and serve immediately.

tips: Squeeze the cauliflower rice in a clean kitchen towel before cooking to remove extra moisture for a fluffier texture.
Hemp seeds mimic the texture and nutty bite of quinoa while keeping total net carbs minimal.
Pair with grilled wild salmon or lemon-herb chicken breast for a complete keto feast.
